summary: Today’s PaymentsDive recap: 8 new stories, with focus on product + fintech innovation.

articles.title: PayCompass, Simpay and Exectras come together
articles.description: The three payments companies have formed a new processing venture that also sells healthcare services to merchants.

articles.title: Merchants call card-fee pact unconstitutional
articles.description: Walmart and other retailers argue that forcing them to stay in a swipe-fee settlement class violates their due process rights.

articles.title: Cross-border contest heats up
articles.description: Technological innovation has enabled fintechs to carve out a beachhead in cross-border payments, but banks still have cards to play.

articles.title: Mastercard, Google push past passwords
articles.description: The card network and the tech titan aim to reduce the need for one-time passwords and catalyze more use of biometric payments.

articles.title: Toast aims to scale drive-thru AI
articles.description: The artificial intelligence company Presto is joining the point-of-sale firm’s ecosystem, seeking to ease restaurants’ use of a voice-order tool.

articles.title: Tokenization: Transforming the future of digital payments
articles.description: Tokenization can help merchants enable smarter, safer and more seamless digital payments—while positioning their business for what comes next.

articles.title: Stripe’s wallet embraces AI bots
articles.description: The payments giant has recently integrated its Link digital wallet for consumers with personal AI agents from Meta, xAI and other AI players.

articles.title: MoneyGram taps stablecoin ally
articles.description: The cross-border company and its rival Western Union are both working with Signify Holdings, aka Rain, to power new digital currency ventures.
